environment.description: Node.js 18 application deployed on EC2 instance. PostgreSQL 15 connection uses role 'migration_admin' with full DDL/DML privileges (GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES). Application accessible on internal network port 3000. No request validation middleware. lodash@4.17.20 installed.

config.database_grants: GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO migration_admin
